description: List the Specification Sections in a Project

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorts the specification sections by number Ex. 'sort=number' Use 'sort=-number' to sort in descending order

id.description: Unique identifier for the specification section.

number.description: Identifying number of the specification section.

description.description: Descriptive title of the specification section.

label.description: Combined label of the section, formatted as "number description".

current_revision_id.description: ID of the section's current revision. Null if no revision exists.

401.description: Company or project is not valid, user is not an active contact
